assumptions: The study window, meal periods and daily study limit are configurable demonstration defaults. Classes, meals and travel do not count toward study minutes.
Available study slots must be provided explicitly. A blank calendar is not evidence of availability. Scenarios A and B use fictional slots.
The 120-minute block limit and 30-minute break are configurable development defaults.
Finishing 24 hours early is a soft preference. A zero buffer does not impose an earlier hard deadline; work must still finish by its stated deadline.
A 40-minute one-way commute is an editable estimate that includes a provisional buffer. Online events do not require travel. No map service has verified this duration.
Do not add another travel buffer unless the user explicitly configures one.
Review travel, late returns and meal conflicts separately. The study window is not an arrival-home deadline.
The published scenario dates, event times and locations are fully fictional. Replace them with reviewed inputs before planning a real schedule.
